Sub Dn Target Monitoring

Isolated monitoring of offices with scoped filters for Division, Sub-Division, Office Type, and SO Name.

Bulk upload format: SOL ID, Office Name, Division, Sub Division, Office Type, SO Name, Annual Target. Select the required Division/Sub-Division/Office filters first. Then download Filtered Bulk Template. It will include only the offices matching the selected filters; existing target values are not copied and the Annual Target column is left blank for entry before upload. Target values are read-only in this viewer and are supplied by the Google Sheet configuration.
